title: Soft Light, Loud Heart
prompt: dance pop in the style of the band big sis
description: A beatless, felt-piano intro blooms into a bright euphoric dance-pop song: pumping supersaw pads, plucky arps and a chopped vocal hook ride a four-on-the-floor LinnDrum groove. It builds through a pre-chorus, lifts into a glossy chorus, strips to an intimate breakdown, then returns bigger before a tender outro.
